observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ang pangunahing punto at angkop na unang hakbang sa sitwasyon, kasama ang dapat tiyakin sa supervisor.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Explains the main point and an appropriate first action in the situation, including what must be checked with the supervisor.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Hindi pa maipaliwanag ang punto o nangangako nang hindi tinitiyak ang kondisyon.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Cannot yet explain the point or makes promises without checking conditions.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tamang paliwanag at hakbang, nang walang untag.
levels.kaya_na_en: Accurate explanation and action without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tamang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng gabay sa detalye.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct direction but needs guidance on details.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi pa angkop ang paliwanag o hakbang.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Explanation or action is not yet appropriate.
